analysis.analysis: The campaign data indicates a strong performance on TikTok with an engagement rate of 8.96%, which is significantly above the industry benchmark of 3-6%. Instagram also performs well with a 5.60% engagement rate, while Facebook and Email show lower engagement rates of 5.36% and 0.00%, respectively. Google Ads and SMS also have an engagement rate of 0.00%. The overall conversion rate of 12.26% is healthy, but the bounce rates vary across channels, with Email and Facebook having higher bounce rates of 0.36 and 0.34, indicating potential issues with content relevance or landing page effectiveness. The average bounce rate across all channels is 0.27, which is acceptable but suggests room for improvement in retaining visitors.

recommendations.title: Increase Investment in TikTok
recommendations.whats_happening: TikTok has the highest engagement rate, indicating strong audience interaction.
evidence: TikTok engagement rate is 8.96%, highest among all channels.

what_you_should_do.step: Reallocate budget to increase spend on TikTok.
what_you_should_do.how: Shift funds from lower-performing channels to TikTok to capitalize on high engagement.
guardrails: Ensure TikTok content remains relevant and engaging.

recommendations.why_this_matters: Increasing budget on TikTok can enhance customer satisfaction by reaching more engaged users.

expected_impact.explanation: Higher budget on TikTok should lead to more impressions and interactions.

dependency_or_risk: Ensure TikTok content quality is maintained.

measurement_plan.how_to_measure: Compare engagement rate and impressions before and after budget increase on TikTok.
measurement_plan.success_criteria: Engagement rate remains above 8.96% with increased reach.
measurement_plan.check_timing: Review after 2 weeks of budget reallocation.
